question: Mukhya Mantri Sikho Kamao Yojana was launched by which of these state governments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Mukhya Mantri Sikho Kamao Yojana** was launched by the **Government of Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• The scheme aims to provide **skill development and employment opportunities** for the youth of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• It focuses on **training students and unemployed youth** in various industries and sectors to enhance their employability.
 
• Youth enrolled in the scheme can **earn a stipend** during their training period.
 
• The initiative is part of the state government’s efforts to address **unemployment and skills gaps** in Madhya Pradesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Skill Development Programs in India**

 
 
• The **Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)** is a flagship scheme by the Government of India for skill training and certification.
 
• It aims to enable a large number of Indian youth to take up industry-relevant skill training.
 
• PMKVY emphasizes both **short-term skill training** and recognition of prior learning.
 
 
 
• **Unemployment in India**
 
 
• India faces challenges related to **unemployment**, particularly among youth.
 
• Skill development schemes aim to bridge the gap between **education and employability**.
 
• Government initiatives like Mukhya Mantri Sikho Kamao Yojana focus on reducing unemployment rates by **providing targeted training programs.**
 
 
 
• **Role of State Governments**
 
 
• State governments play a crucial role in implementing **employment and skill development schemes** tailored to regional needs.
 
• Programs such as Mukhya Mantri Sikho Kamao Yojana are examples of localized efforts to **address skill gaps and unemployment.**
 
 
 
• **Stipend-Based Training Programs**
 
 
• Stipend-based training programs help **motivate youth** to participate in skill development initiatives.
 
• Such schemes ensure that trainees receive **financial support** during their learning period.
